Actor Dhruv Vikram Addresses Personal Life Scrutiny and Remarks

Actor Dhruv Vikram has broken his silence regarding scrutiny of his personal life and recent remarks made by Anupama Parameswaran. Vikram acknowledged that the scrutiny has affected him, stating, "I can't say it hasn't." The coverage indicates his comments follow Parameswaran's remarks, which reportedly described him as a "narcissist."
